verdicts.reason: A uses a sensible left-to-right banner layout: the skull and its yellow bar sit on the left with some margin, followed by the quote and a small attribution. Its flaws: the skull runs nearly the full banner height with little top and bottom room, the right side is left as roughly 100px of dead space, and the attribution is tiny. B uses the same structure but pushes the skull and bar almost against the left edge (the bar starts about 12px in) and leaves about 190px of empty space on the right, so it looks lopsided and cramped on the left. Its quote is also slightly smaller, which hurts readability.
